description:
Heap::graft adds a gift's block to the old blocks and raises live_baseline, so a message dead by the next collection lives until a major, and the raised old bytes push next_generation into a major. Baseline telemetry (1d61f3742, scratch 9x7-11/tel4, an4.py): reqrep 20,001 majors of 20,002 collections, 158 of 164 MB grafted dead when a major finds it; msg 29,292 majors of 106,062; ring 10,704 of 75,009. OTP keeps messages in young heap fragments. fz-gl6.7's reason (a gift is packed and live; its bytes are not allocation) is kept by arm A1. Proposal page (approved 2026-11-17): https://claude.ai/artifact/GuEvNK64ZNHh8gDEQkMF3m (Proposal A).

Experiment first, pre-registered on the page: arms A1 (grafted block young, bytes not counted by should_gc) and A2 (counted, as OTP), vs today, bench host, 25 runs (9 dist-full), interleaved, outputs identical.
Predictions: reqrep majors 20,001 -> <100, msg 29,292 -> <1,000; reqrep/msg/ring held -10%+, cycles -2..-10%; fanin/giftbin cycles <= +2%; controls/distiller/enum instructions within 0.5%.
Pass rule: (1) on >= 2 of msg/ring/reqrep cycles CI upper < 1.00 or held -10%; (2) no workload cycles CI lower > 1.02; (3) no workload median held > max(baseline max, baseline median + max(5%, 256 KiB)).

Done when (if an arm passes): graft puts the block on the young side and its off-heap chain on off_heap_head; graft no longer touches live_baseline/old_blocks/old_objects; the gc event carries received_bytes; heap tests pin a dead gift reclaimed by a minor and a live one copied once; the memory guide's accepted consequence from fz-gl6.7 is rewritten; fixture pins that move are lowered or traced; docs updated; full gate green. If no arm passes: the result is recorded here and closure is proposed to the user.

comments.text: Round 1 (bench, base b237ec0a0+#674, per-arm runtime archives, 25 runs/arm, 9 dist-full, outputs identical): A1 and A2 FAIL the pre-registered rule. Rule 1 met only on reqrep (cycles 0.963, held 152 MB -> 0.3 MB, RSS 85 -> 3.8 MB; majors 20,001 -> 1,267). Rule 2 fails on fanin (A1 1.180, A2 1.308), ring (1.082/1.073), msg (1.040/1.061). Rule 3 fails on fanin (held 1.62/1.54). Predictions missed: msg majors 29,292 -> 8,655 (predicted <1,000) while minors rose 76,770 -> 124,120; msg/ring held rose instead of falling. Telemetry: a gift no longer raises live_baseline, so the young budget stays at the floor and collections run more often. deadbinlive 0.97, giftbin 1.02. Stays open.

title: A received message joins the young generation
